svg.title: hermes-jarvis
svg.desc: An animated sci-fi heads-up display: rotating rings around a pulsing core, a voice waveform, and the words hermes-jarvis, your AI agent, by voice.

g.text: Your AI agent, by voice. Fast, interruptible, yours.

HEY JARVIS ▸ WHAT'S ON MY CALENDAR TODAY ▸ ONE MOMENT, SIR ▸ CHECKING YOUR CALENDAR ▸ YOU HAVE THREE MEETINGS ▸ STOP ▸ HEY JARVIS ▸ WHAT'S ON MY CALENDAR TODAY ▸ ONE MOMENT, SIR ▸ CHECKING YOUR CALENDAR ▸ YOU HAVE THREE MEETINGS ▸ STOP ▸
